core.hostname.description: Fully qualified domain name (FQDN) for this Mailman instance; used in email headers and URLs.

core.spool_dir.description: Directory where Mailman stores queue files and runtime state.

core.default_language.description: Default language for newly created lists and system messages.

core.outgoing_charset.description: Default character set used for outgoing email (must be valid MIME charset).

core.max_recipients.description: Maximum number of recipients allowed per outgoing message (helps prevent abuse).

database.host.description: Database host (empty for SQLite). For remote DB, e.g., 'localhost' or 'db.example.com'.

database.port.description: Database port (0 for SQLite; e.g., 5432 for PostgreSQL).

database.name.description: Database name or file path (for SQLite).

mta.max_message_size.description: Maximum incoming message size in kilobytes (KB) to accept from MTA.

mta.incoming_port.description: SMTP port Mailman listens on for incoming messages (e.g., via LMTP proxy).

mta.smtp_host.description: SMTP relay host for outgoing mail.

mta.smtp_tls.description: Enable TLS encryption for outgoing SMTP connections.

mta.smtp_user.description: Username for SMTP authentication (leave empty to disable auth).

mta.additional_hostnames.description: List of additional hostnames (FQDNs) this Mailman instance serves (used for virtual domains).

items.description: A domain name or FQDN handled by this Mailman instance.

archiver.enable.description: Enable the public archive archiver (e.g., HyperKitty integration).

api.endpoint.description: Base URL for the Mailman REST API (used by administrative tools and web interfaces).

api.password.description: Password for API authentication (must match Mailman internal credentials).

logging.level.description: Logging verbosity: DEBUG, INFO, WARNING, ERROR, or CRITICAL.

logging.path.description: Path to the main Mailman log file.

logging.format.description: Python logging format string for log entries.

logging.rotate.description: Enable automatic log rotation (using size-based rotation).

logging.max_bytes.description: Maximum size (in bytes) of a log file before rotation (default = 10 MB).

logging.backup_count.description: Number of old log files to retain after rotation.
